scenario: LSER.19.8 — a cold `bool_and` is `null`, neither vacuous answer. One assert, one pump, single-pattern `where not r.bool_and` evaluated at assert before any sample is absorbed. `not null` is `null` (Kleene, [LNUL.4.2]) and the rule does not fire. A runtime answering `false` fires (`not false`); one answering the vacuous `true` does not fire, so that case is pinned by the compiler side instead (LSER.19.8_nullable_agg_unnarrowed types the family `T?`). Path: the same cold-value dispatch as LSER.19.8_cold_mean_does_not_fire, on a `Bool` element type.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    active: Bool mutable

schema Warm scope logical:
    d: Int key

series Sensor.active:
    bool_and sliding 10_min

rule cold_bool_and:
    Sensor s where not s.bool_and
->
    emit Warm logical d: 0
